summary: Retest of brute-force lockout fix. All 24/24 pytest tests in backend/tests/test_foundation.py PASS (100%). The critical XFF parsing bug reported in iteration_1 is fixed in both auth_routes.py (login lockout identifier) and audit_service.py (audit ip field). Verified via test_brute_force_lockout (6th attempt returns 429 through the public ingress) and by querying /platform/audit-logs — every entry now stores a single leftmost client IP (e.g. '34.16.56.64') instead of the full comma-separated XFF chain.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: when login is called with a non-existent tenant_slug the endpoint raises 401 before the lockout counter is incremented (auth_routes.py:161-164). This means an attacker who does not know the tenant slug is not rate-limited on that path. Not exploitable for a specific account (requires a valid slug), so low priority — but consider incrementing the identifier counter even on the invalid-slug branch for completeness.
test_credentials: Platform: superadmin@schoolos.dev / SuperAdmin@123. Test tenants use random slug suffix per run.
seed_data_creation: Each run creates riverside-{run6} + hilltop-{run6} tenants and a teacher user; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Foundation backend is green. Run whole file with `pytest backend/tests/test_foundation.py -v -n 0` (serial required because the brute-force test uses a shared victim identifier and state dict). Running the lockout test in isolation will fail because the RIVERSIDE_SLUG tenant is only created by test_register_riverside — that is a test ordering constraint, not a product bug.
rca of the issue: Original bug: request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') returned the entire XFF chain 'client, edge, lb'. Because the intermediate hops rotate on the preview ingress, every request produced a different lockout identifier so MAX_ATTEMPTS was never reached. Fix (applied by main agent): `ip = xff.split(',')[0].strip() if xff else client.host` in both auth_routes.py:148 and audit_service.py:25. Verified: (1) pytest test_brute_force_lockout now returns 429 on the 6th attempt through the external URL, (2) audit_logs.ip is a single dotted-quad.
